purpose: Master registry for project-history/dependency integrity gaps. Scoped implementation registers remain authoritative for their own findings.

findings.title: Work history existed across multiple inventory forms without one immutable identity registry.
28 work-state families did not map by exact program-id to a planning directory and required explicit lineage mapping.
Known non-work-state families were preserved as prose categories rather than first-class registry nodes.
No graph guaranteed every unique work item had a durable path through family/lineage to the wider app.
Global archaeology wiring labels were too coarse to serve as feature-level dependency proof.
findings.repair: Dependency map plus scoped PCV gap register with PCV-I01A/I01B/I01C/I02..I06 ownership; candidate-specific dependencies remain open until PCV-I06.
findings.remaining_scope: PCV_PREIMPLEMENTATION_GAP_REGISTER.json retains 108 detailed findings; PCV-I01A closed 11 at contract level and 97 remain open through PCV-I01B..PCV-I06.

findings.title: No mutation guard prohibited silent rename/delete/reclassification of recorded work identities.
Archaeology validator assumed a permanently closed wiring gate and could not represent later evidence-backed reopening.

completion_rule: PIM-03 may close only when repository validation proves exact inventory coverage, zero unowned structural lineage, explicit treatment of standalone historical lineages, child-gap ownership, and mutation-guard enforcement.

historical_gap_evidence.disposition: historical source-coverage evidence; does not select current work
global canon reconstruction closeout; operational handoff superseded by later PIM/PCV integrity work

closeout.conclusion: Project-level work-history/dependency preservation gaps are closed or routed. Scoped PCV implementation-integrity findings remain open by design and continue to block PCV runtime.
